Economy | Congressman Roger Williams Skip to main content Economy America does not have a revenue problem - we have a spending problem. Decades of reckless policies have pushed our national debt past $37 trillion and fueled inflation that is squeezing families every day. This runaway spending is now one of the greatest threats to our national security. President Trump and Congressional Republicans have taken action to turn things around - cutting taxes for hardworking Americans, lowering energy costs, and bringing jobs home through stronger domestic manufacturing. But Washington must do more to live within its means. I am committed to fighting for responsible spending cuts so that families never have to choose between keeping the lights on or putting food on the table. Some of my work includes: Introduced the Freedom to Compete Act,  H.R. 4869 , which requires all federal agencies to identify and rescind or modify regulations that limit competition or create barriers to entry for new market participants.   Supported the One Big Beautiful Bill Act,  H.R. 1 , which delivers pro-growth tax relief, cuts wasteful spending, and removes burdensome regulations to lower costs, strengthen Main Street businesses, and boost American manufacturing.   Co-led and supported multiple Congressional Review Acts to overturn burdensome and harmful Biden Administration era rules and regulations.   Supported President Trump’s tax incentives for immediate expensing, R&D, and domestic manufacturing, fueling expansion and innovation across Texas. Military | Congressman Roger Williams Skip to main content Military During my time in Congress, I have provided more funding for our warfighters by delivering the highest defense spending in history year after year. I had the privilege of representing one of the largest military bases in the world, Fort Cavazos (formerly known as Fort Hood) for 8 years and still represent military families in my current district. I am proud to have played a crucial role in getting the Army Futures Command (AFC) headquarters to Austin, Texas. In 2018, I was grateful for the opportunity to visit our troops in Iraq and Kuwait during a week-long Congressional Delegation. I witnessed firsthand our operations overseas and heard from leading military officials about how Congress can best serve our men and women in uniform. I will always remain committed to ensuring they have the resources needed to protect our nation. I have been an ardent advocate for expanding funding for the military and will continue working to deliver the resources needed for our servicemen and women to remain the greatest fighting force in the world. Some of my work includes: The House passed my bill, H.R. 1606 , the Veteran Entrepreneurship Training Act of 2023, which provides a path to help veterans begin their entrepreneurship journey in starting a small business through the Boots to Business program.   Supported 9 National Defense Authorization Acts (NDAA), all of which included a pay raise for our troops.   Legislative Victories I got included in the NDAA for Fiscal Year 2024: Increase to the federal contracting goal for service-disabled veterans from 3% to 5%. Eliminated self-certification in Department of Defense contracting, which helps to eliminate fraudulent businesses from receiving government funding and ensures taxpayer contract dollars are going to legitimate veteran-owned businesses.   Supported robust funding during Appropriations for the Impact Aid programs, which is critical to serving military families across Texas.   H.R. 8472, Impact Aid Coronavirus Relief Act , was signed into law. Veterans | Congressman Roger Williams Skip to main content Veterans Thousands of our nation's veterans choose to call Texas home, and I am proud to represent these heroes in Congress. I will always fight for the top-notch healthcare, compensation, and benefits they deserve. If you are a veteran in need of assistance, my team is here to serve you. Click “ Help With A Federal Agency ” under the SERVICES tab to open a case with my office. My work on behalf of our veterans includes: Supported the  National Defense Authorization Act ,  H.R. 5009 , which included full authorization of the Boots to Business program for four years. As Chairman of the House Committee on Small Business, I have continued to vote for and support legislation authorizing and strengthening the Small Business Administration’s Boots to Business Program designed to create entrepreneurial training and education for service members and their spouses transitioning back to civilian life.   Cosponsored the  Veteran Entrepreneurship Training Act ,  H.R. 1606 , which creates a path to help veterans transitioning back to civilian life begin their journey in starting a small business through the Boots to Business program.   Co-led the  VA WEB Act , H.R.6874 , that works to address issues and make improvements to the VA.gov website.   Co-led the  PAWS for Veterans Therapy Act ,  H.R 1448 (signed into law), which improves the VA’s canine PTSD program.   Cosponsored the  Veteran Burial Timeliness and Death Certificate Accountability Act ,  H.R. 4398 . This nonpartisan legislation is designed to eliminate needless delays in veteran burials, ensuring the families of our veterans have the ability to grieve on their own timeline.   Cosponsored the  Simplifying Forms for Veterans Claims Act ,  H.R. 1286 , which aims to simplify forms required by the Department of Veterans Affairs for veterans to receive benefits and services.   Cosponsored the  Military Surviving Spouses Equity Act ,  H.R. 553 , which repeals a provision that prevents beneficiaries of late service members from receiving full benefits.   Cosponsored

Pro-Life | Congressman Roger Williams Skip to main content Pro-Life I am proud to call myself a Christian and conservative leader. Life is a precious gift that begins at conception, and during my time in Congress, I've worked to protect the most vulnerable among us, voting at every opportunity to defund Planned Parenthood and prevent federal funds from being used in the barbaric act of abortion. Some of my work to protect the unborn includes: Co-led  H.R.271 , the  Defund Planned Parenthood Act,  which restricts federal funding for Planned Parenthood, or any of its affiliates. Co-sponsored the  Born-Alive Abortion Survivors Protection Act  ( H.R. 21 ), which establishes affirmative federal protection for babies who survive an attempted abortion. Voted in support of the One Big Beautiful Bill which halts forced tax-payer funding of Planned Parenthood and abortions via medicaid. Voted in support of Amendments to the NDAA that roll back Biden’s dangerous and illegal Department of Defense abortion travel policy. Cosponsored the  Life at Conception Act ( H.R.772 ) ,  commonsense legislation that would require protection for the pre-born under the 14th Amendment, which grants all citizens equal protection under the law and prevents them from being deprived of life, liberty, or property without due process of law. Co-led  H.R.599 , the  Protect Funding for Women’s Health Care Act,  which prohibits federal funding for Planned Parenthood, or any of its affiliates. Cosponsored  H.R.427 , the  SAVE Moms and Babies Act , which prohibits the FDA from approving any new drug intended to terminate a pregnancy. Co-led the  Protect the UNBORN Act ( H.R.407 ),which prohibits the implementation of and funding for President Biden’s pro-abortion Executive Orders. Healthcare | Congressman Roger Williams Skip to main content Healthcare For too long, our healthcare system has focused on treating chronic illness instead of preventing it. That’s why we support the MAHA Commission as it works to uncover the root causes of chronic disease and address them directly. We are committed to protecting and strengthening Medicare and Medicaid by cutting waste, fraud, and abuse so these programs serve those who truly need them—our seniors and the most vulnerable—not able-bodied adults or illegal immigrants. By embracing innovative solutions, we can expand transparency, improve access, and drive down costs for all Americans. We stand with President Trump and Secretary Kennedy in their mission to Make America Healthy Again.  I will always fight to ensure these vital health care providers have the resources needed to continue serving Texans. Some of my work includes: Voted for the Working Families Tax Cuts Act  ( H.R. 1 ), which created the Rural Health Transformation Program, a program that invests in rural health care infrastructure to expand access and enhance quality of care in rural areas. Cosponsored H.R.  1262 , the Give Kids a Chance Act , which accelerates novel treatments for childhood cancer and other rare diseases by giving authority to the FDA to require pediatric trials for combination cancer therapies. Cosponsored H.R. 539 , the Chiropractic Medicare Coverage Modernization Act of 2025 , which modernizes recognition for chiropractors as a “physician” and expands Medicare coverage of chiropractic services to allow all services provided by chiropractors. Cosponsored  H.R.1613 , Drug Price Transparency in Medicaid Act of 2023 , which ends spread pricing in Medicaid programs, leading to low reimbursement rates for pharmacies, and lower health care costs artificially raised by PBMs. Co-led the Personalized Care Act of 2023 ( H.R.4803 ), which offers millions of Americans improved and expanded access to Health Savings Accounts to make Americans' health care more personal and more accessible. Lowering Taxes | Congressman Roger Williams Skip to main content Lowering Taxes The bottom line is that you know how to spend your money better than the government does. I will always fight for hardworking families and workers to have certainty for the future and to put more money back into your pockets. I helped pass the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act of 2017 , the largest overhaul of America’s broken tax code in history, to jumpstart our economy and give people more money in their pockets. I also supported the One Big Beautiful Bill Act , which makes President Trump’s pro-growth tax relief permanent, cuts wasteful spending, and delivers lower costs for hardworking Americans and Main Street businesses. Some of my work to lower your taxes includes: Helped pass the  Tax Cuts and Jobs Act , which was the largest tax reform in decades. This legislation included interest deductibility from my Jump Start America Act .   Repeatedly co-led and fought for the  Death Tax Repeal Act :  H.R.2429 ,  H.R.173 ,  H.R.1105 ,  H.R.198 ,  H.R. 218 ,  H.R.1712 ,  H.R. 7035 , and  H.R. 1301 .   Cosponsored the Main Street Tax Certainty Act , which would make permanent the small business deduction, ensuring our economy continues to grow and allowing Main Street to keep supporting good-paying jobs.   Introduced the  Bring Jobs Back to America Act ,  H.R. 3083 , which encourages corporations to bring jobs back to the United States by reducing the tax rate on foreign earnings if those earnings are reinvested in America.   Introduced the  Incentivize Corporate America Act ,  H.R. 2946 , which implements a flat tax rate on corporate taxable income.   Cosponsored the Access to Credit for our Rural Economy (ACRE) Act ,  H.R. 1822 , which exempts interest earned on loans secured by rural or agricultural property from federal income tax.   Cosponsored the No Social Security for Illegal Aliens Act ,  H.R. 1172 , which prohibits wages or self-employment income earned through unauthorized work from counting toward Social Security benefits, ensuring taxpayer dollars go only to law-abiding, legal

Small Business | Congressman Roger Williams Skip to main content Small Business The hardworking families and small business owners of Main Street are the backbone of our economy. For over 50 years, I have run a family-owned car dealership and calf-cow operation. As a small business owner, I know firsthand how policy impacts day-to-day operations, which guides my decisions as a legislator. As Chairman of the House Committee on Small Business, I am fighting each day to lower taxes and cut the burdensome regulations that hurt small businesses and stifle economic growth. I am committed to ensuring our nation's job creators have the tools and freedom they need to succeed. Visit the  HSBC website to stay updated on the important work my committee is doing to support small businesses in Texas and across the country. Some of my work includes: My bill requires the Small Business Administration (SBA) Inspector General to report quarterly on fraud in certain COVID-19 disaster loans ( H.R. 826 ), the COVID Fraud Transparency Act of 2026 , passed the House of Representatives in June 2026.  My bill, H.R. 5763 , the Main Street Parity Act , passed the House of Representatives in January 2026, which brings parity to all industries in the SBA 504 loan program by eliminating the five percent equity requirement for limited or single-purpose properties.  The House passed my bill, H.R. 3174 , the Made in America Manufacturing Finance Act , which raises the SBA 7(a) and 504 loan limits for small American manufacturers to $10 million and supercharges the return of Made in America manufacturing.  I helped secure House passage of S. 3971 , the Small Business Innovation and Economic Security Act , which reauthorizes the Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR) and Small Business Technology Transfer (STTR) programs through September 30, 2031. These programs provide critical federal funding to help small businesses conduct research and development. Second Amendment | Congressman Roger Williams Skip to main content Second Amendment I will forever be a champion for the Second Amendment – the right of law-abiding citizens to bear arms is a Constitutional liberty that we must protect. That's why I proudly oppose all government regulations that infringe upon your rights and oppose universal background checks, buy-backs, assault weapons bans, and red flag laws. Some of my work to uphold the Second Amendment includes: Introduced the Equal Shot Act , which prohibits the Small Business Administration (SBA) and its Administrator from discriminating against firearm-related businesses in the distribution of financial assistance ( H.R. 4474 ). Introduced  H.Res. 339 ,  a resolution that commends President Trump for his work to protect the Second Amendment and eliminate all infringements on that right carried out under the Biden Administration. Cosponsored   H.R. 3770 ,  the  FIREARM Act,  which   provides protections for law-abiding Federal Firearms License (FFL) holders – granting them the ability to correct minor clerical mistakes and insulating them from ATF retribution.  Cosponsored  H.R. 631, the PARTS Act , which redefines ‘silencer’ to focus on complete devices and a single principal component rather than broad terms in a silencer. The bill also streamlines the purchase of consumable silencer parts, such as wipes, without requiring additional ATF paperwork. Cosponsored  H.R. 38 , the  Constitutional Concealed Carry Reciprocity Act , to make sure all Americans who can legally conceal carry can do so across state lines. I am a cosponsor of legislation that protects sportsmen's and hunters' rights to use firearms on public lands and for sport ( H.R. 877  and  H.R. 1222 ). Voted Against Enhanced background checks ( H.R. 8  and  H.R. 1112 ) that would be burdensome to law-abiding citizens expressing their 2 nd  Amendment right. Spoke out against assault weapons bans  because many guns look like military style weapons, but use small-caliber ammo and are popular for hunting.
